Theorem
[No local collapsing theorem improved] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0401 ↗ thm:chow-ii-appd-no-local-collapsing 1. appD:D.37\group No Local Collapsing

In the preceding finite-time closed setting, for every $\rho >0$ there is $\kappa >0$ such that if $r\leq \rho $ and $R\leq r^{-2}$ on $B_{g(t)}(p,r)$, then \[ \frac{\operatorname {Vol}_{g(t)}B_{g(t)}(p,s)}{s^n}\geq \kappa \qquad (0<s\leq r). \]
